Put your tongue tip in the same spot as for the plain English sound.
At the same time, pull the back of your tongue down and back toward your throat, as if you were starting to say "aw", and tighten the throat a little.
Listen to the vowels next to it. They darken, so the "a" in صباح sounds closer to the "a" in "father" or even "aw". That darkening is often the easiest clue to hear.
